decision.reason: The only evidence is a one-line release highlight [ev-5125d54a5bab]. It says a `RetryOnFailure` lifecycle management strategy was introduced for HelmRelease. It does not say whether the strategy is opt-in or becomes the default, and it does not name the HelmRelease field that selects it. Without that, we can't tell whether every HelmRelease user is exposed (the proposed gvk-in-use condition), only users who set a particular field, or no one. What is missing: the HelmRelease API field path and the default behaviour of the strategy (opt-in vs default), for example from the helm-controller changelog or the CRD schema diff.
